## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Strict borderless 2D flat-vector fluid motion-graphics animation, preserving the first-frame composition: a centered spiral made of turquoise, vermilion, cobalt blue, mustard yellow, and cream solid-color bands on a flat turquoise background. No outlines, no black contours, no gradients, no texture, no realistic lighting, no cast shadows, no 3D volume, and no photographic detail. The spiral spins rapidly clockwise in place, then its colored bands stretch outward like soft rubber, inflate, and fold into the head, mane, legs, and flowing tail of a vermilion-and-mustard Chinese zodiac horse. In an extreme close-up, the horse gallops diagonally upward from the lower left toward the upper right, its hooves expanding on impact and its mane whipping in several directions. The mane melts into thick turquoise liquid, drips downward, splashes upward, and wraps around the horse’s head to form two curved goat horns.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.500, the same turquoise liquid continuously unfolds into a close-up of a turquoise-and-cream goat leaping upward and then twisting counterclockwise in midair. Its horns bend, inflate, and fold over the face; its beard stretches into long liquid strands that drip and bounce. The goat’s body compresses into a dense mustard-yellow blob, which bursts into rounded droplets. The droplets fly outward, orbit the center, and recombine into the curled tail, limbs, and expressive face of a playful monkey.

[Shot 3] At 00:05.000, without a cut, the mustard droplets regroup into an extreme close-up of a cobalt-blue monkey swinging in a wide arc from right to left. Its arms stretch elastically beyond the frame, its torso inflates during the swing, and its curled tail loops around the camera in a clockwise spiral. The monkey releases its grip and spins rapidly; its tail flattens into a vermilion ribbon, its fingers split into feather-like filled shapes, and the ribbon folds upward to create the comb, beak, wing, and chest of a rooster.

[Shot 4] At 00:07.500, the vermilion ribbon continuously folds and re-aggregates into a close-up of a mustard-yellow rooster flapping upward. Its wings open wide, collapse inward, and open again with exaggerated squash-and-stretch. The rooster rotates briefly around its vertical axis while solid feather shapes fly off, splash into small color droplets, and fall in curved paths. The droplets are pulled together by the rooster’s spinning wing, forming a large turquoise shape that wraps around the body and liquefies into the ears, snout, and wagging tail of a dog.

[Shot 5] At 00:10.000, the turquoise wrap opens from the center into an extreme close-up of a cobalt-blue dog running toward the camera, then veering sharply to the left. Its nose inflates toward the lens, its ears flap in opposite directions, and its body stretches into a long horizontal ribbon before snapping back into a compact running form. The dog dives through a vermilion puddle; the puddle splashes over its back, drips from its ears, and engulfs the entire silhouette. Inside the engulfing shape, the dog’s snout expands into a rounded pink form, its ears fold downward, and its body re-forms as a cheerful pig.

[Shot 6] At 00:12.500, without any hard cut or ordinary transition, the vermilion liquid re-aggregates into a close-up of a pink-and-mustard pig trotting in a bouncing circular path around the center of the frame. Its snout inflates and contracts rhythmically, its ears fold forward and spring back, and its curly tail spins like a small solid-color vortex. The pig rolls toward the camera and briefly fills the frame. Its body then melts into a glossy-looking but completely flat solid-color liquid pool; the pool splashes outward, drips from the upper edge, and is pulled into long colored ribbons. The ribbons wrap around one another, fold, stretch, and re-aggregate into clean lowercase letterforms. At 00:14.200, the final centered title reading "minimax-h3" forms through continuous liquid morphing, with each letter swelling, dripping slightly, and settling into a crisp uniform solid-color shape on the turquoise background. The title remains fully readable and gently pulses until 00:15.000. The title must be created from the pig’s liquid silhouette with no hard cut, fade, dissolve, preset wipe, outline, gradient, texture, or ordinary title animation.

overall_soundscape: Clean abstract motion-graphics sound effects follow each deformation: a fast rotating whoosh for the opening spiral, elastic hoof impacts and stretched rubber sounds for the horse, liquid drips and rounded splashes for the goat, swinging air swells and flexible snaps for the monkey, crisp wing flaps and falling droplets for the rooster, short running taps and a broad engulfing suction sound for the dog, and soft bouncing impacts with a final liquid swirl for the pig. No realistic environmental ambience.

non_diegetic_music: A fast modular electronic rhythm with dry percussion, irregular marimba pulses, soft synthetic bass, short reverse swells, and elastic pitch bends. The rhythm continuously evolves with each animal: rotating accents for the horse, upward accents for the goat, swinging syncopation for the monkey, rapid fluttering percussion for the rooster, sharper running beats for the dog, and rounded bouncing bass notes for the pig. End with a bright sustained tone at 00:15.000.

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the brown-haired bunny-eared young woman shown in <Picture 1>, with long brown hair, cyan-blue eyes, a black oversized coat with turquoise-blue panels, a blue skirt, dark tights, and blue sneakers. Preserve her long hair silhouette, tall ears, cyan eyes, black-blue-turquoise palette, and energetic expression in simplified flat-vector form.
<Subject 2> is the pale white-haired cat-eared young woman shown in <Picture 2>, with yellow-green inner ears, vivid green eyes, a pale cream cape-like garment, a lime-green outfit, dark brown boots, and small charcoal and yellow-green details. Preserve her white hair silhouette, cat ears, green eyes, lime-cream costume palette, and calm smile in simplified flat-vector form.
<Subject 3> is the tan-haired fox-eared young woman shown in <Picture 3>, with large twin tails, amber-orange eyes, tan ears, a white outfit with black and red panels, red geometric accessories, and long red-and-black ribbon-like shapes behind her. Preserve her twin-tail silhouette, fox ears, orange eyes, red-white-black palette, and playful expression in simplified flat-vector form.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video is a 15-second borderless 2D flat-vector fluid motion-graphics animation. <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> hold hands and run together before jumping into a flat graphic pool. The splash expands into clouds, revealing <Subject 3> riding a magic staff through the sky. She waves toward the camera, flies diagonally out of frame, and leaves a colorful fluid trail that transforms into a floating sky garden. <Subject 1>, <Subject 2>, and <Subject 3> enter one by one and form a close-up group portrait, which re-aggregates into the final text "minimax-h3".

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): partially_preserved - her brown hair, bunny ears, cyan eyes, black-blue-turquoise clothing, and energetic personality are retained while her design is simplified into large uniform vector shapes.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): partially_preserved - her white hair, cat ears, green eyes, lime-cream clothing, and dark boots are retained while fine costume details are reduced to clean filled silhouettes.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): partially_preserved - her tan twin tails, fox ears, amber eyes, red-white-black costume, and red ribbon shapes are retained in a simplified flat-vector design.

detailed_description:
The target video uses strict borderless 2D flat-vector fluid motion graphics, constructed entirely from clean, uniform solid-color shapes with generous negative space. Use a restrained palette derived from the three references: deep charcoal, turquoise blue, lime green, warm cream, coral red, tan, and amber. Separate every form through contrasting fills and negative space only. Use close shots, extreme close-ups, elastic squash-and-stretch, liquid ribbons, expanding color fields, match-on-color transitions, and foreground occlusion wipes. No outlines, black contours, gradients, texture, grain, realistic shadows, bloom, photographic detail, 3D volume, or hard cuts.

[Shot 1] A close-up begins on the joined hands of <Subject 1> and <Subject 2>, then rapidly pulls out to a tight side view as they run hand-in-hand from left to right. <Subject 1> has flowing brown hair, tall bunny ears, black and turquoise clothing, and blue accents. <Subject 2> has white hair, cat ears, a lime-and-cream outfit, and dark boots. Their arms swing in sync, their hair and cape shapes lag behind with elastic motion, and their feet create small flat teal ripples. At 00:01.700, both characters leap forward together toward a shallow graphic pool. Their joined hands stretch into one continuous turquoise ribbon as their bodies enter the water.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.400, the impact creates a huge flat splash made from cream, turquoise, lime, and blue solid shapes. The splash rises from the bottom and fills the frame, folding over the camera like a liquid curtain. Individual droplets stretch into soft cloud puffs, and the water surface continuously re-aggregates into a pale blue sky with layered cream clouds. No realistic reflections or transparency.

[Shot 3] At 00:04.200, <Subject 3> rides a slender deep-charcoal magic staff with a coral geometric tip, entering from the upper-right corner in a close-up diagonal flight. Her tan twin tails stream behind her as red and black ribbon shapes. She approaches the camera, leans forward with a playful smile, lifts one hand, and gives a cute quick wave directly toward the lens. At 00:05.600, she turns the staff downward and flies toward the lower-right corner. Her red, turquoise, lime, and cream color trails stretch across the screen and become a sweeping fluid wipe.

[Shot 4] At 00:06.700, the colorful trail opens into a floating sky garden made from flat cream platforms, teal cloud layers, lime plants, and simple coral flowers. <Subject 1> runs toward the camera from the center background, filling the frame in a medium close-up. She stops, turns toward the lens, smiles, and waves. At 00:08.700, <Subject 2> walks in from the right edge and settles beside her. At 00:09.700, <Subject 3> enters from the left edge, her twin tails forming red curved shapes that frame the composition. The camera pushes in with large amplitude as all three lean closer together.

[Shot 5] At 00:11.200, the three characters form a cheerful close-up group portrait. <Subject 1> remains on the left, <Subject 2> in the center, and <Subject 3> on the right. Their hair, ears, ribbons, and costume blocks overlap into one readable graphic silhouette. They smile and wave together. A circular cream frame expands behind them while their colored shapes stretch outward, fold inward, and merge into a compact multicolor emblem.

[Shot 6] At 00:13.800, the emblem splashes into clean coral, turquoise, lime, and charcoal letterforms. The final centered text reads exactly "minimax-h3". The letters assemble with elastic overshoot and settle by 00:14.500, holding clearly until 00:15.000.

overall_soundscape:
Synchronized footsteps, fabric movement, and soft breathing accompany the hand-in-hand run. The water entry produces a broad flat splash, followed by airy cloud puffs, staff-flight whooshes, a quick hand-wave swish, drifting ribbons, flower pops, and a crisp group-portrait snap-like accent as the three silhouettes merge.

non_diegetic_music:
A 128 BPM bright motion-graphics score using plucked synth, marimba, light kick, hand percussion, and short bell tones. Add a rising sweep during the water-to-cloud transition, accented notes during <Subject 3>'s wave and diagonal flight, then a tight rhythmic build that resolves with three clear tones when "minimax-h3" finishes assembling.
